answer: Each identity locks 25 tokens in a haven escrow, then answers 32 canary prompts drawn by a public randomness beacon, sampling at temperature 1 and posting raw token logs. Any hunter can submit two identities whose logs share a long sampled run with probability under 2^-60, proving a common seed. The escrow pays the hunter 70 percent of both bonds and bans the pair. A 10,000 clone swarm must lock 250,000 tokens (about $25,000) and fund independent entropy, roughly 400 GPU-hours per epoch, or forfeit it. Shared seeds betray clones like hairline cracks in cast basalt columns.
